retired_requirements.reason: Compresses two distinct exceptional processing permissions and six mandatory safeguards/conditions into one article-level abstraction and merges materially different actor scopes.

migration_notes: Article 4a was inserted by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 and is expressly cross-referenced by amended Article 10(1) and Article 10(6).
The paragraph 1 permission is separated from each mandatory condition because each condition can independently fail while the processing activity occurs.
Paragraph 2's express statement that it creates no obligation to conduct bias detection or correction is preserved as a qualification on the paragraph 2 permission.

requirements.requirement_summary: A provider of a high-risk AI system may exceptionally process special categories of personal data only to the extent strictly necessary for bias detection and correction under Article 10(2)(f) and (g), subject to appropriate fundamental-rights safeguards and all Article 4a(1) conditions.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed for bias detection and correction
requirements.governance_expectation: Limit exceptional processing of special-category personal data to what is strictly necessary for bias detection and correction and satisfy the Article 4a(1) safeguards and conditions.
applicability_conditions: Processing is for bias detection and correction in relation to a high-risk AI system under Article 10(2)(f) and (g).
exceptions_or_qualifications: This is an exceptional permission, not a general authority to process special-category personal data.
Applicable EU data-protection law continues to apply in addition to Article 4a.

requirements.requirement_summary: Before relying on the Article 4a(1) permission, establish that bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(1)
governed_object: Decision to process special categories of personal data for bias detection and correction
requirements.governance_expectation: Use special-category personal data only where other data, including synthetic or anonymised data, cannot effectively fulfil the bias-detection and correction objective.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(1) exceptional processing permission.

requirements.requirement_summary: Apply technical limitations on re-use of the special-category personal data and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, including pseudonymisation.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(1)
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed under Article 4a(1)
requirements.governance_expectation: Restrict re-use and protect the data with state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(1) exceptional processing permission.

requirements.requirement_summary: Secure and protect the special-category personal data with suitable safeguards, including strict access controls and access documentation, and restrict access to authorised persons subject to appropriate confidentiality obligations.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(1)
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed under Article 4a(1)
requirements.governance_expectation: Protect the data against misuse through suitable safeguards, controlled and documented access, authorisation and confidentiality obligations.
evidence_expectation: Access-control and access-documentation evidence where Article 4a(1) processing occurs.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(1) exceptional processing permission.

requirements.requirement_summary: Do not transmit or transfer the special-category personal data, or otherwise make it accessible, to other parties.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(1)
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed under Article 4a(1)
requirements.governance_expectation: Prevent transmission, transfer or other access to the special-category personal data by other parties.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(1) exceptional processing permission.
constituent_propositions: no other access by other parties

requirements.requirement_summary: Delete the special-category personal data when the bias has been corrected or when the applicable retention period ends, whichever occurs first.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(1)
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed under Article 4a(1)
requirements.governance_expectation: Delete the data at the earlier of bias correction or expiry of the retention period.
timing_or_frequency: At the earlier of bias correction or the end of the retention period.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(1) exceptional processing permission.

requirements.requirement_summary: Record why processing special-category personal data was strictly necessary for bias detection and correction and why the objective could not be achieved by processing other data.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(1)
governed_object: Records of processing activities for Article 4a(1) processing
requirements.governance_expectation: Document the strict-necessity rationale and the insufficiency of other data in the applicable records of processing activities.
evidence_expectation: Records of processing activities containing both required reasons.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(1) exceptional processing permission.
constituent_propositions: reason the objective could not be achieved with other data

requirements.requirement_summary: Providers and deployers of other AI systems and models, and deployers of high-risk AI systems, may exceptionally process special categories of personal data only where strictly necessary for bias detection and correction concerning the specified health, safety, fundamental-rights or prohibited-discrimination risks.
applicable_actor: Provider of another AI system or model
Deployer of another AI system or model
Deployer of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed for bias detection and correction
requirements.governance_expectation: Limit Article 4a(2) processing to what is strictly necessary for bias detection and correction concerning the specified risk classes.
applicability_conditions: Processing is strictly necessary for bias detection and correction.
The possible bias is likely to affect health or safety, negatively affect fundamental rights, or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law, including where outputs feed future operations.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 4a(2) does not create an obligation to conduct bias detection or correction.

requirements.requirement_summary: When processing special-category personal data under Article 4a(2), apply all conditions and safeguards set out in Article 4a(1).
applicable_actor: Provider of another AI system or model exercising Article 4a(2)
Deployer of another AI system or model exercising Article 4a(2)
Deployer of a high-risk AI system exercising Article 4a(2)
governed_object: Special categories of personal data processed under Article 4a(2)
requirements.governance_expectation: Apply every Article 4a(1) condition and safeguard to Article 4a(2) processing.
applicability_conditions: Applies when exercising the Article 4a(2) exceptional processing permission.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 4a(2) does not create an obligation to conduct bias detection or correction.
